args.lesson: Worked: forum.ghost.org Discourse JSON (search.json, /t/<id>.json) is readable without an account, unlike Reddit/UKBF. GitHub contents API and raw files gave the upstream converter source (ExtendedQuoteNode.ts) to ground the fix. Of 3 candidates, 2 rejected (staff-answered; needs host access). Selected t/60053 (blockquote+br loses text): unresolved but 14 months old. Workaround passes 10/10 on synthetic fixtures, but Ghost is not installed, so its import effect is an untested hypothesis. Failed: a guessed GitHub path 404'd and one EXEC lacked mkdir. Next time, list dirs before guessing and mkdir in every write. Free forum help where vendors answer free shows a problem, not willingness to pay. Posting needs an account we lack.
